original_ai_output.title_zh: 马沙尔在朱巴法庭否认领导“白军”
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹前第一副总统里克·马沙尔10月26日在朱巴特别法庭出庭作证时，否认领导被指参与2025年3月纳西尔军营袭击的武装青年团体“白军”。他称“白军”是松散组织的平民青年群体，不受苏丹人民解放运动反对派（SPLM-IO）指挥或资助。检方指控SPLA-IO部队与“白军”联手在袭击中杀害257名南苏丹人民国防军士兵，并损毁或缴获价值约5800万美元的军事装备。庭审休庭至10月28日。

key_facts.fact: 马沙尔在朱巴特别法庭否认领导“白军”
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Former First Vice President Riek Machar on Monday denied leading the White Army, telling the special court in Juba that he does not command the armed youth group

key_facts.fact: “白军”被指参与2025年3月纳西尔军营袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the armed youth group accused of taking part in the March 2025 attack on a military garrison in Nasir, Upper Nile State

key_facts.fact: 马沙尔称SPLM-IO对“白军”无政治或军事控制
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the movement had no political or military control over the White Army

key_facts.fact: 检方指控袭击致257名南苏丹人民国防军士兵死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Prosecutors allege that SPLA-IO forces allied with the White Army killed 257 South Sudan People’s Defence Forces soldiers

key_facts.fact: 检方称被毁或缴获军事装备价值约5800万美元
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: destroyed or captured military equipment worth about $58 million
The court adjourned the hearing until Wednesday, October 28, 2026

uncertainties: 检方指控内容尚未经法庭裁决证实
马沙尔关于“白军”不受SPLM-IO指挥的说法为其单方辩护陈述
目前仅单一来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
